predictions.rationale: Main class that defines the State Diagram type in the classic ArgoUML UI layer; creates and manages the diagram, so it is central to the feature.
Graph model for State Diagrams; manages the underlying nodes/edges representing states and transitions.
Renderer that converts model elements into figs for display in State Diagrams; essential for visual presentation.
Initialization class that registers the State Diagram with ArgoUML; ties the diagram into menus and factories.
Alternative/newer implementation of the State Diagram in the state2 module; directly provides the same feature in a modular form.
Graphical figure representing an individual State on the diagram; core visual element.
Model helper offering convenience functions for state machines; heavily used by diagram code to manipulate states/transitions.
Graphical figure for transitions between states; another fundamental visual component of State Diagrams.
UI action that lets the user add a new Transition in a State Diagram; directly supports interaction with the feature.
Superclass for many state‐related figs (state, pseudostate, etc.); provides shared behaviour for diagram elements.
